title: BSA Handoff Manifest
description: Schema for handoff_manifest.json produced by bsa-handoff-packager. The manifest is the integrity record for the H1-H4 handoff pack; it is consumed by bsa-no-new-claims-auditor, bsa-citation-auditor, and downstream verification tooling.

pack_id.description: Stable identifier for this handoff pack instance. Typically '<RunID>-handoff-<sequence>'.

pack_version.description: SemVer version of the pack contents. Increments on any re-emission.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of manifest emission.

canon_policy_version.description: CanonPolicyVersion active at the time the pack was built. Format: '<semver>+hash:<sha256-prefix>' per contract-versioning.md (Sprint 3 US-S3-04). Pre-Sprint-3 runs accept bare '<semver>'.

includes.description: Paths to the four H-pack files inside the handoff proposal folder.

h1_path.description: Relative path to H1 exec brief markdown.

h2_path.description: Relative path to H2 delivery packet markdown.

h3_path.description: Relative path to H3 validation packet markdown.

h4_path.description: Relative path to H4 open items packet markdown.

evidence_binding_map_path.description: Relative path to handoff_evidence_binding_map.csv — the cross-reference of every [C-xxx], [AJ:C-xxx], [A51-xxx] citation used across H1-H4 to its originating canonical row.

no_new_claims_verdict.description: Result of the bsa-no-new-claims-auditor pass over this handoff pack.

leakage_count.description: Count of non-analyst_judgment statements in H1-H4 that do not trace to a canonical A59 row or A51Ref.

analyst_judgment_valid.description: Count of ClaimType=analyst_judgment rows referenced in H1/H4 whose JustificationRationale correctly references ≥ 1 upstream ClaimID different from its own (INV-07).

analyst_judgment_invalid.description: Count of ClaimType=analyst_judgment rows referenced in H1/H4 with missing or self-only JustificationRationale — these count as leakage (INV-07).

report_path.description: Relative path to handoff_no_new_claims_report.md produced for this pack.

checksum.description: Integrity checksum over the H1-H4 bodies and the evidence binding map.

algorithm.description: Hash algorithm. SHA-256 is the only supported value in v1.0.

digest.description: Hex-encoded digest over the concatenation of covered files, in the order listed in 'covers', with '\n' separators.

covers.description: Ordered list of relative file paths hashed into the digest. MUST be exactly [h1_path, h2_path, h3_path, h4_path, evidence_binding_map_path].

discovery_lineage.description: Optional block describing discovery-to-main lineage when the run used discovery_then_bsa mode. Omitted in direct mode.

notes.description: Optional free-text notes for humans — never parsed by downstream tooling.
